rows.summary: normalizeResume() now runs withSectionShapes() on every load, import, restore and cloud merge: a null or non-object section or entry is dropped, items that is not a list becomes one, sections that is not a list becomes []. The editor, PDF, Word, Markdown and JSON Resume export all work on such a file.

A section or entry with no id, or an id another already holds, gets its own (deterministic: <type>_<n> / <sectionId>_item<n>, the same on every load); every valid id is kept, the first holder keeping a repeated one. Editing, renaming or deleting one no longer hits its siblings.
A section with no title gets its type's title (custom's for an unknown type), and one with no items an empty list: the PDF and editor render it.

A section's Grids stored as text or out of range is stored as a whole number from 1 to 4 ("2" → 2, 7 → 4); 0 or no number is dropped so the template default prints, as it did. "2" on five entries prints two to a row.
Dashboard → Import sets reader.onerror/onabort: a file the browser cannot read shows the editor's AUD-23 message ('That file could not be read…'), cleared after 4 s, and imports nothing.
Same defect as R2-085 (fixed there). Its Job Tracker half was already fixed by e9c48c3 (J-23: readImportFile sets onerror/onabort).
Same defect as R2-085 (Dashboard fixed there); the Job Tracker import already reported read errors since e9c48c3 (J-23).

A photo stored as a URL or path is never handed to react-pdf: printableImage fetches it once a session and the PDF prints that copy, or no photo at all (no ring, no gap) when it cannot be fetched or is not an image; the Photo panel then says 'Not printed' and that the link could not be loaded. Header Customization's Photo ↔ Text row follows the photo as printed.
Photo → Height shows only when the shape the PDF draws (photoOption) is not a circle: an imported 'oval' shows Circle and no Height.

Contact Details' Style and Layout chips read the value as the PDF and Word print it (contactStyleOf/contactLayoutOf): an unknown style shows Bar, an unknown layout Justify, a blank style Icon; the icon controls stay hidden where no icons print.

The photo, contact-icon and letter-photo uploads measure the whole résumé (sections included) against the cloud document's room: on a long résumé the upload is refused with RESUME_IMAGES_TOO_LARGE instead of breaking sync.

issues: 09bc832: the Photo panel's new link line called startsWith on a photo stored as a number/object (crash)
09bc832: headerGapRows read the raw photo, so Photo ↔ Text vanished for a URL photo whose fetched copy prints
73aa4f3: Grids 0 was stored as 1, changing Languages/References (default 2) from two to a row to one

notes: Changed existing assertions: tests/pdf/16-saved-data-text-fields.test.mjs fixture gave every section's second entry the id 'x_item1' (now unique, since loading de-duplicates ids, R2-055); tests/unit/image-upload.unit.mjs and tests/pdf/16-saved-data-photos.test.mjs pinned 'a plain URL is drawn as it is', the behaviour R2-093 names. tests/pdf/16-saved-data-photo-size.test.mjs now stubs fetch, so its https://example.com photo never reaches the network. Leftovers: useLetterPhoto still says a URL photo's 'format can't be printed' on the Cover Letter panel (wording only). Non-skills sections keep Grids 3–4 after the clamp while their panel offers only 1–2 (PDF draws them; outside R2-110). Section shape normalization is always-run, not a DATA_VERSION migration.
